Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: native pixel-art JRPG civilian actor.
References: first image identifies the civilian's clothes, props and role; second image Bram is the accepted game style and COMPACT body proportions. Redraw the civilian, not Bram.
Technical request: square 1024 x 1024 transparent canvas representing an actual 64 x 64 pixel drawing enlarged exactly 16 times. Each logical pixel is a flat 16 x 16 square on one grid. Deliberately draw at 64px first: broad clean color clusters, stepped contours, no thin subpixel strokes, grain, dithering, noise, antialiasing, blurred edges or texture filtering. Each eye must be a clearly placed dark logical pixel with light skin pixels around it; separate eyes and a simple mouth, readable without tiny facial texture. Dark warm outlines, restrained upper-left highlights and cool shadows. Compact late-16-bit JRPG proportions, around three heads tall like Bram; human, warmly expressive and dimensional, not a tall realistic miniature.
Framing: full body standing idle, front view with slight overhead camera. Height approximately 60 logical pixels = 960 actual pixels, with 32 actual pixels transparent margin above and below. Centered with all boots and props inside canvas. No ground, floor, shadow, text, numbers, labels, panel borders, UI, extra people or alternative poses. True transparent background. Do not tightly trim the image. Clothing must form clean connected shapes, hands must connect visibly to arms.
Subject: One adult male dock worker: navy work cap, blue rolled-up sleeves, ochre vest, brown trousers and sturdy boots, holding a wooden parcel securely in both hands at waist level. Friendly tired face, distinct dark eyes. Broad worker build. Limit silhouette to about 32 logical pixels wide.
